description: Hardware-agnostic machine learning infrastructure for .NET. Implements high-performance neural network layers in C# that transpile to WebGPU, CUDA, OpenCL, and WebGL via SpawnDev.ILGPU. Optimized for Blazor WebAssembly and native GPU execution.
releaseNotes: v5.2.7 - Live-stream audio: a streaming resampler, a sparse mel filterbank, and the counters that found them. NEW StreamingResampler: rate conversion for a LIVE microphone stream whose output is BIT-IDENTICAL to a whole-buffer AudioPreprocessor.Resample. Resample renormalises the kernel where its window overruns the SIGNAL EDGE - correct for one clip, wrong applied per chunk of a stream, because it then declares every chunk boundary an edge. A microphone delivers a frame every ~10 ms, so that is a broadband tick 100 times a second, which is exactly what a voice-activity detector reports as speech; MediaInterop.FromAudioDataAsync(data, targetRate) was doing it on every frame, so any caller asking MediaStreamCapture for a target sample rate got it. FIX: the Whisper mel filterbank was applied densely - 80 mels x 3000 frames x 201 frequency bins, about 48 million multiply-adds on the single WASM thread - but a Slaney mel filter is a TRIANGLE that touches a handful of those bins and is exactly zero elsewhere, so roughly 95% of that work multiplied by zero and added it. Each mel now runs only over its non-zero span; bit-identical, since 0 * power == 0 and x + 0 == x exactly in IEEE 754. MEASURED in a browser demo: the CPU mel STFT fell from 4786 ms to 3236 ms of a transcription, and it is a FIXED cost because the audio is padded to a flat 30 s before any of it runs - which is why adding a voice-activity endpointer shortened the RECORDING from 30 s to 3.7 s without shortening the transcription. NEW GraphExecutor cumulative counters (CumulativeReset plus CumulativeRunCount/TotalMs/ReadbackCount/ReadbackMs/SyncDrainCount/SyncDrainMs): every LastRun* field is overwritten by the next RunAsync, and most real pipelines are not one call - Whisper is an encoder pass plus N decoder steps, ZipVoice is NumSteps Euler iterations - so reading LastRunTotalMs after a 14-second transcription reports the final decode step and makes it look like 40 ms, a measurement that invites a confident wrong conclusion. What they found is the opposite of the Silero VAD result: readbacks are 3% of a Whisper transcription and were 66% of a VAD frame, same backend and same executor. TranscriptionResult also carries MelTimeMs and ModelTimeMs, because the executor's counters cannot see work that never reaches the executor. Also: BufferPool.TraceRents (ML_TRACE_RENTS=1) logs every named rent for diffing capture/replay passes. Full six-backend PMT sweep green: 4899 passed, 0 failed, 58 skipped. See CHANGELOG.
